outcome: safety of vIBT (adverse events like uterine perforation, anaphylaxis, endometritis)
cohort: Women who experienced primary postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) and underwent vacuum-induced intrauterine balloon tamponade (vIBT).
finding: Vacuum-induced intrauterine balloon tamponade (vIBT) was found to be safe, easy to perform, and effective in controlling bleeding in most patients with postpartum hemorrhage.
